text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Italian President gives his support in Skopje for Macedonian integration in EU and NATO.
- Bulgarian Prime Minister Stefan Sofianski to visit Macedonia on Thursday evening to discuss economic cooperation.
- Police stopped students demonstrating in front of parliament during Scalfaro's visit.
- Police start to detain students. Some students say they will begin hunger strike on March 10 over law allowing classes to be held in Albanian in teachers' academy.
